PhD candidate in the Chapman lab at Stony Brook University. In my research I analyze the local and average structure of Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) and other materials with X-ray scattering methods.

## Education

**Stony Brook University** | Stony Brook, NY  
Ph.D. in Chemistry | 2021 – present

* In situ characterization of framework materials
* X-ray diffraction and pair distrution function analysis of structral transitions
* Expected graduation: May 2027

**Leipzig University** | Leipzig, Germany  
M.Sc. in Chemistry | 2018 – 2021

* Thesis: Development of multicomponent alloys for fuel cell applications

**Leipzig University** | Leipzig, Germany  
B.Sc. in Chemistry | 2014 – 2018

* Thesis: Influences of neutral salt depleted mother liquor on the MFI-synthesis
